subject: Television & Streaming
title: Squid Game: Korea's Global Breakout
description: One-minute skill: Squid Game: Korea's Global Breakout.

hook.text: Squid Game became Netflix's most-watched series in history within weeks.

buildup.text: Creator Hwang Dong-hyuk spent over a decade trying to get it made. Korean studios rejected it.

discovery.text: The show's childish games with deadly consequences created a visual language that transcended subtitles.

twist.text: Squid Game merchandise, memes, and Halloween costumes flooded the world.

climax.text: Squid Game proved that non-English content can be the biggest thing in entertainment.

punchline.text: The show about capitalism's cruelty became capitalism's hottest product.

quiz.question: How long did Squid Game take to go from concept to production?
options: It was made in one year
Creator Hwang Dong-hyuk spent over a decade trying to get it made
It was produced in three months
